message: 七番目の魔将
I wonder what everyone is hiding.
Nanaka probably asked them to keep it a secret, though.

name: Paqy
message: 「Does Soba's secret bother you that much?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, of course it does, but I'm not thinking about it while on patrol!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmm.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what Melilot-san and Azel are doing......」
I force myself to switch gears.

name: Paqy
message: 「Why don't you just ask them tomorrow?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think they'll answer?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well. Probably not.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I have no choice but to find out myself」

name: Synn
message: 「It was...... right here, wasn't it」
I crouched down and looked around. Only paved ground stretched out before me.
If Melilot-san's actions are connected to what Azel said--'It's been destroyed...... An enemy?'--then something must be here. Or must have been here.
I can't see any traces at all. Even when I run my hand over it, it's just plain asphalt.
Still, Melilot-san was investigating something. And Helena-san is probably aware of it too.
And did Azel also investigate that same thing and find it destroyed? Was it her enemy who destroyed it? And if it could be destroyed, does that mean it had a physical form?
What if that something was connected to Pasta and the others wandering around the academy?
They were clearly different from the other demons.
On a whim? That couldn't be. They were far too organized for it to be a whim.
I think...... they were doing something at the academy based on some kind of plan.
And Azel's enemy? What does that mean? Is there still an unknown faction out there?
Argh, it's all 'something' this and 'something' that!

name: Voice
message: 「It is hardly admirable for the Student Council President to take the lead in breaking school rules.」
I spun around as if startled. There had been no presence or sound at all.

name: Melilot
message: 「Go home. It is past the hours when students are permitted to be here.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you doing here yourself, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I am a staff member.」
I stood up.

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way Helena would permit a mere staff member to wander around in the middle of the night」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you saying one needs permission to take a walk in their own yard?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I live in the library. Naturally, the chairwoman knows this as well. Does that satisfy you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think that would satisfy me?」

name: Melilot
message: 「At the very least, I believe it makes more sense than you roaming around without permission, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go back」

name: Synn
message: 「You're investigating whatever Pasta and the others made, aren't you」
It's a bluff.

name: Synn
message: 「I can't see anything. And the reason I can't see it is because it's camouflaged to stay hidden」

name: Synn
message: 「But you can see it, Melilot-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta and the others stopped showing up. That's because they achieved their goal... because that 'something' is finished. And Helena knows about it too. Am I wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「With Helena's approval, you're investigating that--」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems you have no intention of leaving」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you admitting it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let me help too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous and Soltia are strong. I only sensed their presence once, but I could tell. It's far too dangerous if you run into them alone, Melilot-san」

name: Synn
message: 「So I'm coming with you」

name: Synn
message: 「I just want to protect the academy and everyone in it. Please, let me help!」
Melilot-san stared fixedly at me.

name: Synn
message: 「Please!」
I bowed my head.

name: Melilot
message: 「Ha」
I raised my head. Melilot-san was sneering.

name: Melilot
message: 「Not 'us,' just 'me'? That is quite an arrogant way of putting it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Arrogant?! I--」

name: Melilot
message: 「So you are saying the rest of the Student Council's strength isn't even worth mentioning.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I can't let everyone fight Bylous and Soltia--」

name: Melilot
message: 「And you think you can fight them?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because you're the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How do you know that?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you defeat the enemies yourself, no danger will befall them. I see. What tremendous arrogance.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, you're trying to do this all by yourself too, Melilot-san!」

name: Synn
message: 「An ordinary human taking on opponents even the Demon Lord can't beat all alone... Isn't that arrogant too?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heh.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Fuhahahaha.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Excuse me. I couldn't help but laugh. Still, it's your fault for saying such a thing, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Something I said...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, when the very best you can manage is getting in my way, how could I do anything but laugh at a remark like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Me, getting in your wa--」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha?!」
He vanished! Before I even had time to register the thought, a hand was placed on my shoulder.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey?! Are you kidding me?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You can't even perceive this level of speed?」
My shoulder is pushed lightly from behind, and I involuntarily stumble forward.

name: Melilot
message: 「Go home. Like that, you won't be able to protect anyone.」
I can't protect anyone, not even Nanaka!?

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true!」
My hair stands on end, and a scorching power fills my entire body.
The Demon Lord's power. Invincible, bearing the title of king of all demons. The strongest.

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't fall for the provocation! She's got complete control over her magic--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Great Sage Paqy. Don't you think a child ought to be taught the importance of knowing their place?」

name: Melilot
message: 「And that the night is no time for children!」
I see her!
A speed no ordinary human could ever hope to follow.
But right now, I'm the Demon Lord.
A sense beyond mere sight catches the movements I couldn't see a moment ago!
I catch the shadow squarely in front of me just as it tries to slip into my blind spot!
Still, I can't unleash the Demon Lord's power directly on her.
I lightly reach out a hand toward the shadow's shoulder--

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Melilot
message: 「You are falling significantly short of your theoretical visually trackable speed.」
Her voice comes from behind. Before I can even turn around, my shoulder is shoved.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah」
Even clad in the Demon Lord's power, my body is effortlessly pushed aside, sending me staggering.
I barely manage to dig my heels in and avoid the disgrace of dropping to my knees, though.

name: Paqy
message: 「It's no use. The way you are right now, Master Synn, you can't even touch her--」

name: Synn
message: 「That can't be!」
With my power, I should be able to protect her!
I should be able to make sure Nanaka never has to wear that frightened look again!
With the Demon Lord's power! That's what the Demon Lord's power is supposed to be for!

name: Paqy
message: 「Well... maybe this is a good opportunity.」
I don't sense any magical power from Miss Melilot at all.
In that case, she's an ordinary human. Just a trained, ordinary human.
There's no way the Demon Lord could lose out to that.
I focus my awareness on the power surging inside my body.
My temples begin to throb with sharp pain.
I forcibly seize hold of the raging, still-uncontrollable power of the Demon Lord.
I see her! No, I feel her!
Yet her presence slips away just a hair's breadth past my outstretched fingers.

name: Synn
message: 「Why?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I would put you at roughly thirty percent of your calculated potential output at this point in time.」
She vanished!?
No, did Melilot-san surpass my speed again!?
She's even outpacing the Demon Lord's senses!?

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems Sakura-kun lacks resolve.」

name: Synn
message: 「I am! The Demon Lord! That's why I can use this power too!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if you have decided to become the Demon Lord, you lack the resolve to bear the burden.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true!」
No matter how frantic I get, she dances from blind spot to blind spot, and I can't even catch a trace of her presence.
How can she move like this!?
How can someone without even a hint of a demon's presence do this!?

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, this one's a Demon General.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way!? She doesn't have even a shred of magic power...」

name: Paqy
message: 「How the hell could someone with no magic power use acceleration magic? She's perfectly controlling and concealing the flow of her magic.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that even possible!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It'd be impossible if she were going all out. Which means this ain't her full strength.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even like this!?」
So you're telling me that I--the Demon Lord--am an opponent she doesn't even need to go all out against!?

name: Paqy
message: 「She's the seventh Demon General. Probably from the Record-Keepers, the Nive Clan.」
A voice came from my blind spot. Just like a ghost possessing my back.

name: Melilot
message: 「So the time has ripened for that name to resurface from the depths of oblivion.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't underestimate me, shut-in. Yours truly is a Great Sage.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, please add a footnote to that profound knowledge of yours.」
Right by my ear.

name: Melilot
message: 「I hate that name.」
Dead ahead. I didn't even feel her presence.
A flash of light! A heavy blow like an iron hammer struck the arms I instinctively threw up!

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaaaaah!」
A dull ache that rattled me to the bone! I was effortlessly blown back, landing flat on my rear.

name: Synn
message: 「Guh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Compressing magic power to the point of physical manifestation just to throw a punch? And while holding back, at that. Pretty impressive.」
I stagger to my feet. My head throbs with pain.

name: Melilot
message: 「Go home. Had I been so inclined, you would have lost your life seventeen times over.」
I tried to say something. Yet no words came out.

name: Melilot
message: 「Your flow of magical power is completely erratic as well. In that state, you won't even be able to maintain your Demon Lord form anymore.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not--」
Suddenly, a violent wave of dizziness washes over me. Primary-colored lights flash behind my eyelids.
I can't stay standing. I drop to my knees. The Demon Lord's power unravels.
Melilot-san looked down at me in that state.
Not with contempt, not with amusement, not with pity, it was simply--

name: Melilot
message: 「In your current state, Synn-kun, the only fate awaiting you if you face Bylous--no, Soltia--is decisive defeat.」
Gentle.
